description: Org-wide rules (schedule, grouping, automerge, the .tekton re-synth, the peer-range rule) live in tektonic-ci/core's renovate/tektonic-ci.json. Only this repo's image pins stay here.

customManagers.description: Image pins: self-ci.ts (which .tekton/ is generated from) and DEFAULT_GCS_CACHE_IMAGE in src/gcs-backend.ts.

packageRules.description: DEFAULT_GCS_CACHE_IMAGE is exported, user-visible, and recorded in CHANGELOG.md when it moves, so its bump waits for a human to add that entry instead of automerging with the rest of the ci images group.
